quote: I have had the honor of attending several events where Max was the emcee. Not everyone can do what he does so effortlessly. His energy, his humor, and passion always brings each room to life. He is very skilled at making everyone engaged and energized.
name: Zulfat Suara

quote: I chose Max for our city council forum because I had seen him emcee other events and was impressed with his quick wit, intelligence, and enthusiasm. He did not disappoint! He brought a perfect amount of humor while leading a respectful discussion between the candidates.
name: Elizabeth Sanfelippo

quote: His wit, charm, and poignancy is unmatched and I could not imagine hosting an event like ours without such a titan.
name: Jackie Miller

quote: He hosts with an approachable eloquence, an acute wit and effortless charm. But what truly stood out and surprised me was how much detail, care and customization he brought to the big day. He asked all about our relationship, our tastes, our beliefs, and used our answers to create a ceremony that was beautifully specific, subtly hilarious and even involved our friends and family in clever ways. Everyone went out of their way to tell me how much they loved the ceremony.
name: Bryson Schmidt

quote: If you’re looking to throw a crazy office party, need a quirky emcee for grandma’s birthday, or want to put together a fundraiser for your nonprofit, I hope you’ll consider bringing him on. You won’t regret it. I promise.
name: Michael Rudulph

quote: It’s the age of AI, most things can now be easily copied. So what are you doing to stand out? Call Max, put on an event that people will talk about. Boring is risky.
name: Austin Senseman
